name: carboncanopy-solutions
description: CarbonCanopy Solutions — carbon, forestry & agroforestry consultancy website (React + Node.js + Tailwind CSS).

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client,chrome -c green,cyan,blue "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev:client" "cmd /c start chrome http://127.0.0.1:5173"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
